# Diamond Ray Louden - https://drl.bio

> Personal portfolio for Diamond Ray Louden: multidisciplinary builder focused on applied AI, Next.js/React systems, and pre-sales / sales engineering across IT and cybersecurity.

## Summary
Diamond Ray Louden (Chicago) ships applied AI agents, automations, and retrieval systems (including AWS Bedrock RAG), alongside full-stack web work in React and Next.js. Background spans Accenture (commerce, NLP training for Amazon Project Neo, accessibility), sales engineering, and independent R&D at Quincy Labs.
